decision.main: Keep per-date LLM interpretation and forecasting as actual reasoning nodes. Freeze common interpretation artifacts to isolate forecast-node policy revisions; separately assess the complete pipeline when claiming graph improvement.
decision.closest_lightweight_comparator: Outcome-summary instruction adaptation inspired by ATLAS Adaptive-OPRO, using a protected experimental forecast-node skill and unchanged return evaluator.
decision.attribution_boundary: This adapts a protected prompt-revision pattern. It is not an ATLAS/StockSim reproduction, and ATLAS is not specified as scalar-only feedback.
decision.numeric_controls: Keep no-change, historical-mean/regularized prediction and inner-fit scalar shrinkage as controls under the exact same horizon and decision accounting. A finite symbolic residual rule is an optional research-product control, not the main LLM graph.
decision.why: The experiment should test whether richer development feedback improves later LLM decisions beyond competent frozen instructions, calibration and equally funded search. A different executor, label or action space would obscure that question.

paper.title: ATLAS: Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS Through Dynamic Prompt Optimization and Multi-Agent Coordination

sources.mechanism: Market/news/fundamental summaries feed an order agent. Adaptive-OPRO edits only static instructions, retaining runtime placeholders and output interfaces. Section4 supplies meta-prompt, scored history and recent interaction summaries; appendixF.5 injects history_text. K=5 daily steps score clipped cumulative ROI. Accepted edits act on later windows.
sources.evaluation: Engineered static prompts, weekly reflection and Adaptive-OPRO share execution semantics; seven backbones and three runs/configuration over regime-specific two-month equity simulations. Deterministic execution abstracts slippage, impact, latency and intraday partial fills.

code.license: README declares MIT; no dedicated LICENSE file present in this inspected revision
code.boundary: AppendixJ names an updated environment and configs/o4-mini-adaptive-opro-config.yaml. The inspected public main/website heads lack that config and optimizer/reflection modules. Analyst/template/decision code is verified; the Adaptive-OPRO implementation is paper-described.

sources.adopt: Protected editable instruction block, complete prompt/history records, delayed maturity, competent static and reflection controls.
sources.defer: StockSim services/order simulator and paper reward transform; preserve the experimental return-forecast contract and its unchanged evaluator. This is distinct from native CP1/CP2 admission.

paper.title: Qlib: An AI-oriented Quantitative Investment Platform
paper.license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; code license is separate

sources.mechanism: Numerical research platform separates dataset preparation, model fitting, signal records, portfolio strategy and backtest. Current workflow code explicitly separates train/valid/test; LightGBM fits train/valid, predicts features on test. RollingGen supports expanding/sliding windows and truncation.
sources.hard_target_convention: Alpha158 default Ref($close,-2)/Ref($close,-1)-1 is shifted close-to-close. YAML uses close execution, TopkDropout50/5 and explicit costs. None matches next-session open-to-close, three-stock long/cash automatically.
sources.data_boundary: Current README says official data temporarily disabled and Yahoo-derived data imperfect. Platform reuse does not authenticate point-in-time prices.
sources.adopt: Fit-only preprocessing, separated forecast/portfolio evaluation records and declared rolling-label maturity.
sources.defer: Full Qlib runtime and default benchmark task; small numerical controls should use Zenith admitted data and its declared target.

paper.title: QuantaAlpha: An Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining

sources.mechanism: Hypothesis→symbolic AST→code→backtest trajectory. Paper mutation freezes a prefix, revises a localized low-reward action and regenerates the dependent suffix. Complexity/redundancy gates constrain expressions; evaluated parents support crossover.
sources.evaluation: CSI300 chronological train2016–2020, valid2021, test2022–2025; roughly150 factors per agent feed the same downstream LightGBM. Factor IC/RankIC and portfolio metrics differ from three-stock point forecasting.

code.license: README MIT badge; dedicated LICENSE absent in inspected revision
code.boundary: The inspected MutationOperator generates an orthogonal hypothesis from parent hypothesis/factors/metrics/feedback. It does not itself implement the paper frozen-prefix localized-action algorithm. The semantic consistency checker is LLM-mediated; structural limits are deterministic.

sources.adopt: If testing compiled residuals, restrict operator vocabulary and size, retain full trial lineage, and compare under one downstream model.
sources.defer: Unrestricted coding/crossover search and its correction retries; current main study remains bounded LLM instruction revision.

paper.title: R&D-Agent-Quant: A Multi-Agent Framework for Data-Centric Factors and Model Joint Optimization

sources.mechanism: Research hypotheses become coding tasks, numerical backtests and feedback; factor/model directions are scheduled. Current RDLoop records experiments and failures in trace; factor feedback compares IC, cost-adjusted excess return and drawdown to current best.
sources.adopt: Retain failed attempts, executable task interfaces and hypothesis/implementation/evaluation lineage.
sources.defer: Joint factor/model optimizer and bandit controller; they add search dimensions unnecessary for one native forecast-node change. Source inspection does not prove its evaluation meets our prospective secrecy or point-in-time conventions.

comparator_contract.shared: Same admitted per-date information, saved interpretation artifact, forecast functional/horizon, frozen model/provider and decoding configuration, validators, objective, candidate count and selection rule.
arms: Competent frozen forecast-node policy, retained as unchanged option.
Trace-conditioned proposals: complete development denominator and bounded actual input/output traces, including successes and failures.
Outcome-summary proposals inspired by Adaptive-OPRO: scored policy history and declared recent outcomes, with actual retained-input/node traces withheld.
Feedback-blinded proposal generation: same declared priors/interfaces and search allowance, without outcomes, scores, selected winners or later-round winner feedback.
comparator_contract.selection: Freeze all proposals before a common untouched validation block; retain the whole candidate bank plus unchanged. Validation selection can use outcomes in all arms, so blinded means generator-blinded, not an entire algorithm without feedback.
comparator_contract.conditional_vs_end_to_end: Shared saved interpretations isolate forecast-node updates. Whole-pipeline tests are separate; identical interpretation instructions do not guarantee identical stochastic artifacts.
comparator_contract.failures: Retain every attempted forecast/proposal and operational failure. Declare failure treatment for economic decisions separately from predictive-loss coverage; never rank only accepted outputs.
comparator_contract.assessment: Hide later outcomes from proposers and selectors until final assessment; freeze chronological boundaries, label maturity, trial budget and reporting rule before calls. Historical replay with later-trained LLMs remains developmental, not contamination-free evidence.
comparator_contract.financial_functional: For a new next-session open-to-close target C_next/O_next-1, issue after prior completed close, keep the future open/close out of predictors, and freeze entry/exit/cost/position conventions. Existing next-close price-error study remains a different contract.
comparator_contract.testable_claim: Under the shared interface and research budget, trace-conditioned proposals improve later decisions more than outcome-summary and generator-blinded proposals; a negative result remains useful.
comparator_contract.claim_not_supported: This review establishes neither profitability nor automatic graph learning, causal attribution, differentiability or novelty.
comparator_contract.implementation_boundary: The proposed return reasoning graph is experimental. Its bounded skill text and return evaluator must not be described as the native CP1/CP2 policy/evaluator or as native-cohort completion.

optional_compiled_control.mechanism: A small deterministic residual expression over declared past-only inputs can test whether a cheaper research product matches daily reasoning.
optional_compiled_control.identifiability: A linear residual on the same ridge features is redundant with coefficient refitting. Include ridge recalibration/scalar shrinkage, or use declared conditional/nonlinear terms if the intended hypothesis is richer structure.
optional_compiled_control.boundary: Factor/program search is already close prior art in QuantaAlpha and RD-Agent; a grammar or compiler alone is not a new learning contribution.

novelty.operator_origin: Local operator insight is persistent reasoning skills and context selected from experience. Prior source anchors remain in docs/learning-synthesis.json; independent local articulation is not a priority claim.
novelty.overlap: Protected prompt updates, trajectory feedback, localized revision and executable factor search have close precedents. A node/graph label does not create novelty.
novelty.remaining_question: Does source-bound trace/context feedback improve measured later LLM decisions under a fixed task and matched budget beyond outcome-only adaptation and simple calibration? This is a falsifiable performance question, not an established unique mechanism.
